events.title: Electric Contrasts: the Art of the Detail
events.description: Electric Contrasts: The Art of the Detail brings together photobooks and magazines to show how the revolution of photography in the late 19th and early 20th centuries changed the history of art.
events.blurb: Browse photobooks and magazines tracing how early photography reshaped art history at the McMurtry Building.

events.title: Korean Indigenous Futures: The Art of Kim Bong-Jun
events.description: The East Asia Library at Stanford University will host a print exhibition by Kim Bong-Jun, a leading figure in Korean Minjung (People's) Art, from September 29 to December 11, 2026.
events.blurb: View prints by Kim Bong-Jun, a leading figure in Korean Minjung People's Art, at Lathrop Library.

events.title: Emergent Properties: Decennial Reflections on Collections
events.description: In 2026 the David Rumsey Map Center celebrates its tenth year—a moment to reflect on how the Center has added value to scholarship on campus and around the world.
events.blurb: Browse the David Rumsey Map Center's decennial exhibit reflecting on ten years of its collections.

events.title: Book spells
events.description: Boil, boil, toil and trouble… what bewitching book will you find at the Education Library? Our witchy book display has a little bit of magic for everyone!
events.blurb: Browse the Education Library's witchy book display for spellbinding reads of every kind.

events.title: The Frontier Between Legendary Monsters and Verified Natural History
events.venue: Sapp Center for Science Teaching and Learning
events.description: Have you ever looked at a mysterious lake shadow and thought, "Is that a giant prehistoric plesiosaur, or just an extraordinarily dramatic floating log?"
events.blurb: Examine the exhibit weighing legendary monster sightings against verified natural history at the Sapp Center.

events.title: Art of Remembrance Ofrenda Exhibit
events.address: 150 E San Fernando St, San Jose, CA 95112
events.description: View ofrendas created by local artists, offering perspectives on traditional and contemporary visual arts.
events.blurb: See ofrendas made by local artists at King Library.

events.title: Text Machines: Scarlet Thread of the Digital Order (1883-2026)
events.blurb: Browse the Text Machines exhibit on digital order at Green Library's Bing Wing.

events.title: A Vision of Paris: The Roxane Debuisson Collection at Stanford
events.blurb: View the Roxane Debuisson Collection's vision of Paris at Green Library's Bing Wing.

events.title: Touch Me Not: 12th Annual Undergraduate Juried Exhibition
events.blurb: Browse undergraduate work in the 12th annual juried exhibition at the Art Gallery.

events.title: Something Sensational to Read: A Tour of Silicon Valley LGBTQ+ Publications, 1950 to Today
events.address: 150 E San Fernando St, San Jose, CA 95112
events.blurb: Tour a collection of Silicon Valley LGBTQ+ publications spanning 1950 to today at King Library.

events.title: Artist Reception & Gallery Talk with Zoe Caron
events.address: MVCPA SecondStage, 500 Castro St, Mountain View, CA 94041
events.description: A free artist reception and gallery talk featuring Bay Area artist Zoe Caron, exploring high-contrast realism and the natural world as part of the Nature's Pulse exhibition; doors open at 5:00 PM with the talk beginning at 6:00 PM.
events.blurb: Meet Bay Area artist Zoe Caron and hear her discuss high-contrast realism at the Nature's Pulse gallery talk.

events.title: TRUST Team Tabling
events.address: Mission Branch Library, 1098 Lexington St, Santa Clara, California 95050
events.description: The Santa Clara City Library hosts the TRUST team for a monthly tabling visit, where they provide information about their mental health and substance use support services to community members.
events.blurb: Stop by the TRUST team's table to learn about mental health and substance use support services.

events.title: How to Become a City Vendor Workshop
events.description: City of Mountain View staff walk attendees through the steps to become a goods or services vendor with the City and share resources for staying informed about vendor opportunities.
events.blurb: Learn the steps to becoming a Mountain View city vendor and find resources for upcoming opportunities.

events.title: Adulting 101: College Paths Panel
events.address: The View Teen Center, 263 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: A panel discussion where Teen Center staff share personal experiences with college applications, majors, gap years, and life after graduation.
events.blurb: Hear Teen Center staff share personal stories on college applications, majors, and life after graduation.

events.title: AfterHours: Witches & Warlocks
events.address: The View Teen Center, 263 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: A Halloween-themed evening with a Hocus Pocus screening, spooky snacks, potion-making crafts, and costumes encouraged.
events.blurb: Watch Hocus Pocus, snack on spooky treats, and make potion crafts in costume.

events.title: Document Shredding Event
events.address: SMaRT Station, 301 Carl Road, Sunnyvale, CA
events.description: Free public document shredding event where residents can safely dispose of sensitive paperwork at the SMaRT Station.
events.blurb: Drop off sensitive paperwork for free, secure shredding at the SMaRT Station.

events.title: CEFCU Halloween Movie Night
events.address: PayPal Park, 1123 Coleman Ave, San Jose, CA 95110
events.description: Free family-friendly Halloween movie screening at PayPal Park, presented by CEFCU, with free parking and admission; gates open at 5:30 p.m. and the movie starts at 6 p.m.
events.blurb: Watch a free Halloween movie screening under the lights at PayPal Park with free parking included.

events.title: El Niño Storm Preparedness Workshop
events.description: The San José City Manager's Office of Emergency Management hosts an online workshop to help residents prepare for the upcoming El Niño storm season.
events.blurb: Log on to learn storm readiness tips from San Jose's Office of Emergency Management ahead of El Niño season.

events.title: Hysterical: Mary Lynn Rajskub
events.description: Comedian and actress Mary Lynn Rajskub, known for '24' and 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia,' performs stand-up exploring modern womanhood.
events.blurb: Watch comedian Mary Lynn Rajskub, known for '24' and 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia,' riff on modern womanhood.

events.title: Monster Bash Family Bike Ride
events.description: A family-friendly Halloween bike ride meetup at 9:30 a.m. with the ride beginning at 9:45 a.m., part of the city's Monster Bash celebration.
events.blurb: Ride bikes with your family through a Halloween-themed Monster Bash route starting at the Mountain View Public Library.

events.title: Rent Stabilization 101 Workshop
events.address: Senior Center Social Hall, 266 Escuela Ave, Mountain View, CA
events.description: An in-person workshop covering the key points of rent stabilization and tenant protections in Mountain View, open to tenants and landlords.
events.blurb: Learn the key points of Mountain View's rent stabilization rules and tenant protections at this in-person workshop.
